function: Recipe-pinned projection of anchor ownership onto declared organs, with separately bounded static evidence.
capabilities: Project existing recipe obligations to organ ownership
Bind static observations to recipe, mapping, and scanned source
adaptation: Compatibility is determined by interface and recipe acceptance tests; this label is advisory.
verified_with: Current organ projection/evidence implementation and tests/test_organs.py cover pinning, ownership, graph mapping, stale inventory, and explicit non-acceptance.
provenance: Current KPP MantleOS source; repository paths are explicit pointers and are never fetched or executed during Pantry discovery.

usage.use_when: Select when a recipe needs explicit organ ownership for its existing acceptance anchors.
inputs: Optional bounded source scan and bindings
outputs: Recipe-bound ownership projection or source-bound observations with gaps
usage.limits: Projection and static evidence do not grant authority, execute candidate code, establish runtime behavior, or grant KPP acceptance.
